name: B10-0255/2025 (PPE) – Return of Ukrainian children forcibly transferred and deported by Russia
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the return of Ukrainian children forcibly transferred and deported by Russia
part_text:
The European Parliament condemns Russia for taking Ukrainian children from their homes and families. It says over 19,000 children have been deported or kept in occupied areas, and only 1,293 have returned. It calls on Russia to stop, give information about the children, and return them. It asks other countries and courts to hold those responsible to account, and says returning the children must come first in any peace talks. This is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a new law.

- The Parliament formally condemns Russia and demands it stop taking children and return them.
- It affects Russia, Ukraine, the deported children and their families, and international courts.
- Next, the resolution is sent to EU institutions, member states, Ukraine and international organisations; any real change depends on Russia and future negotiations.
